run_semantic_segmentation_training: run the semantic segmentation training loop with encoder decoder architecture on a dataset
train_one_epoch: train one epoch of the segmentation module with forward pass backward pass and logging
save_checkpoint: save encoder decoder state dicts and training history as checkpoint files per epoch
group_weight_for_optimizer: group module weights into decay and no-decay groups for SGD optimizer parameter groups
adjust_learning_rate_poly: adjust learning rate using poly decay schedule based on current iteration and max iterations
